description: Runs the Android Automotive build of Google Maps (26.10.120003.E) on BYD DiLink 3 head units (Android 10) as "Maps Car" with MicroG-RE 7.3.0: sign-in, map, search, navigation and voice, a UI density setting, the car's battery for EV routing (on by default on the tested BYD Dolphin), Send to car from phone Maps, an in-app problem report that is sent only after you review it, and a safe mode with feature switches. BYD battery, Send to car, the BYD location flicker fix and BYD navigation volume are separate patches. Requires Morphe Desktop 1.20.0 or newer.

patches.name: BYD battery (EV)
patches.description: Feeds the BYD battery into Maps' EV routing (battery on arrival, chargers). On by default on the tested BYD Dolphin, off with an "untested" notice on other BYD models; a Settings row turns it on or off.

patches.name: BYD location flicker fix
patches.description: Holds back BYD's brief location off/on flips for up to 3 s, so Maps does not flash its location lockout.

patches.name: BYD navigation volume
patches.description: Plays Maps' spoken directions on BYD's navigation volume instead of the media volume.

patches.name: Google Maps Automotive for MicroG-RE
patches.description: Runs Google Maps for Android Automotive on Android 10 as "Maps Car" with MicroG-RE 7.3.0. Adds a UI density setting, a problem report and a safe mode.

patches.name: Send to car
patches.description: Lets phone Maps send a trip to Maps Car through MicroG-RE (push routes, the notification service identity and maps.app.goo.gl links).

release_notes:
- New patch **BYD navigation volume**, on by default: spoken directions play on the car's navigation volume instead of the media volume (#1).
- Maps Car no longer closes itself right after it starts on head units that declare Android Automotive and run apps as the system user, such as DiLink 5 (#3).
- BYD battery: on head units without the DiLink 3 SDK, it now reads the car adapter that DiLink 5 uses, and starts from the car's own average consumption. One Sealion 7 owner tried it in #3; I haven't tested DiLink 5 myself.
- The red Report Maps Car icon now appears after Maps Car's first start. On DiLink 5, whose launcher shows one icon per app, it stays hidden, so open the report from **Settings › Report a problem**.

Tested on a BYD Dolphin (DiLink 3.0, Android 10) with Google Maps (Android Automotive) 26.10.120003.E and MicroG-RE 7.3.0. Other BYD models are untested, and BYD battery does not support plug-in hybrids (DM-i).

Setup: [README](https://github.com/fangkampanat/google-maps-automotive-patches#install).
